authority: Read-only finite recipe, not execution authority. Root may use it only after an actual v10 user receipt and exact frozen proposal/bundle validation. Prior v9 approval is not inherited.
prerequisites: Use pinned installed Python and campaign allowlisted environment/cwd only after successful timed-install receipt.
Enter the remote lane only after previous work is settled, controller can_admit=true and current is empty. No resetting inherited faults/reservations.
Canonical Server ready and exact campaign identity/owner verified; Connector ready with exact task/instance/digest before transfer. No additional lifecycle action beyond the eight reserved ones.
Reattach historical accounting before each phase and retain it while requests are in flight; no unresolved request or selected fault can be cleared by this recipe.

operator_bootstrap.note: data.authenticated may already be true under trusted loopback even when configured=false. Configured=true is not permission to overwrite an existing account.
operator_bootstrap.temporary_password: Generate one temporary >=12 and <=1024 character password in memory; no secret in argv, files, reports, captured request headers/body or public logs.
operator_bootstrap.transport: Direct loopback/proxy-disabled bounded HTTP; no forwarded headers, no personal cookie, and do not set x-nexus-operator-session-required=1 on the fresh-account bootstrap.
operator_bootstrap.lost_response: GET status only; never repeat account POST blindly. If configured is now true and the same generated password remains in memory, the canonical login can confirm that credential. If material is unavailable or state differs, stop rather than rotate.

login.stdin: Generated own password in memory only, from canonical fresh-account bootstrap described in proposal; never a personal credential.

operator_bootstrap.require_login: exit0, state authenticated, exact origin and canonical Server ID. Canonical OperatorProfile uses its own protected vault namespace; no plaintext fallback or operator credential delivered to Connector.
operator_bootstrap.reservation: Durably reserve account creation and login once in own public nonsecret metadata before each dispatch; no password/request-body logging. Lost or unavailable state is not permission to replay.

connector_draft.meaning: Only final Save draft choice, with exact installation/project/provider supplied. Unexpected prompt/choice or mismatching draft stops review; no credential here.
assertions: One exact inventoried candidate is selected by harness+absolute executable. No candidate prompt if unique; otherwise stop instead of feeding guesses.
Project/provider paths already supplied, existing and absolute; --no-start-at-login bypasses startup question and preserves current service mode.
Only final Save draft selection consumes 1\n (option1=True; default is Cancel). No credential read/import here.

exit0, awaiting_operator_bootstrap, request_id=m1v10-connector-setup, runtime_started=false; draft format/version, origin, candidate_ref, project/provider selection, configuration and start_at_login=false match proposal.
No replay of draft command if local intent already exists with conflicting explicit selection.

remote_plan.result: Canonical own operator_home/terminal/profiles/m1v10-remote.json. Review scope and write public/remote-review-selection.json with exact proposal_sha256/review_revision/server_id/profile before transfer.
assertions: document.review_revision == remote_review.review_revision; server_id equals authenticated Server

Root reviews exact new agent/workspace, candidate, configuration, permissions, limits, remote_machine_policy/previous_machines and children before approval. No approval merely from matching display names.

protected_transfer.rule: Use the frozen wrapper and protected concurrent PTY helper. Do not substitute an ad-hoc shell pipe or print one-shot key. Producer has no --json; consumer alone has OKTO_NEXUS_CONNECTER_DAEMON_FG=1.
protected_transfer.preconditions: No existing handoff/transfer reservation; reviewed current profile; exact controller/current and owner checks.
protected_transfer.success: TRANSFERRED_ONCE; both exits0; auxiliary job empty; no forced cleanup; canonical profile done on same Server; same task/instance/digest, canonical service owner outside auxiliary Job. Retain handoff/Finish metadata without key.
protected_transfer.unknown: Non-replayable reservation. Fence effects and retain observation until auxiliary worker returns. Explicit Job0 and worker-exit proof precede selected normal service stops, including Connector without a work request. Missing proof remains unknown. Scheduler effects are external; canonical desired=draining and physical exit/task proof remain required.
protected_transfer.reference: m1_v10_remote_setup.py, remote_transfer_monitor.py and remote_stop_order.py from the final approved bundle

close_and_get_recovery.selection_rule: Use only the campaign checkpoint session. If --session-id is used for close, take the exact retained session; omit --session-id for status/watch so the control intent and operation are included.
success_oracle: exact same intent/operation/session and binding scope
exact session lifecycle_state=CLOSED; read actual DTO field instead of inferring from exit0
usage collector caught up and ownership/drain checked independently
close_and_get_recovery.uncertainty: No second close/interrupt, resume, new session or new work to resolve an unknown result. Preserve checkpoint; GET-only observation; normal stop only through the existing lifecycle reservation. No force.

canonical_get_routes.decision: GET /api/v1/approvals/{exact_approval_id}, then only the returned executed_result.decision_id via GET /api/v1/runtime-management/runtime/approval-decisions/{id}; confirm same approval_key/request_hash/intent and native_stage=CONFIRMED.
canonical_get_routes.scope: Revalidate current actor/Server and exact server/executor/binding/agent/workspace/session tuple. Missing receipt or SUBMITTED is not terminal success.
canonical_get_routes.warning: work resume --control is NOT GET-only: terminal_work.resume may call _admit when operation=None (186-200). Use status/watch --control without --session-id or explicit GET. close exit0/admitted is not proof of closure.

conclusion: Static v10 path/policy/sequence review only. No HTTP, provider, real account, credentials, services or product command executed. Actual canonical IDs and native command decisions must be reviewed from the current campaign when available.
